verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a mobile Git client, and an integrated terminal is a reasonable thing to ask of such a developer tool, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions terminal sessions, let alone multiple sessions with their own context, appearance and history. Its SSH references cover Git transport, keys and server-side repository listing, and iPad multi-window covers the repository status sheet, not terminals.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can open multiple terminal sessions, each with its own context, appearance, and history
